evals.prompt: Initialize a maintained project in this empty directory with Markdown linting and hooks. No application stack yet.
evals.expected_output: Minimal docs, mise lint tools, grouped just recipes, and working local Git hooks.
assertions: No application package manifest is created.
The justfile exposes Setup and Linting groups.
Markdown and commit-message hooks are exercised.
Linters and automatic formatters exclude repository-root raw/ while checking maintained files.
The README contains a title, short project status, and a glossary reading link.
Creates a meaningful root glossary from confirmed terms or reports missing domain input without inventing definitions.
No commit or remote is created without a request.
Pinned tools and local hk hooks use mise; setup is exposed through just setup.
No placeholder just run recipe is added without an application.
Inherited EditorConfig settings are respected and project-specific secret paths are checked before staging.

evals.prompt: Start this project with the minimal setup. The directory already has a README and a package.json.
evals.expected_output: Inspect existing files and ask before adapting the empty-directory baseline.
assertions: The agent asks whether to adapt the baseline.

evals.prompt: Make a disposable POC in this empty directory. No tests or linters.
evals.expected_output: Route to prototype-selection without initializing maintained project tooling.
assertions: No linting or hook baseline is installed.

evals.prompt: Create a Next.js app with deployment in this empty directory.
evals.expected_output: Route to scaffold-nextjs rather than applying the stack-free baseline.
assertions: The request is identified as application scaffolding.
The project-init baseline is not substituted for the requested app.
